title: Greek-Style Portobello Mushroom Kebabs
description: Inspired by traditional Greek kebabs, these vegan portobello mushroom kebabs are a flavorful and satisfying twist on a classic dish, capturing the essence of Mediterranean cuisine.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together Greek vinaigrette and fresh oregano.
Brush mushrooms, red onion, red bell pepper, and zucchini with the vinaigrette mixture, and season with salt and black pepper.
Thread the marinated vegetables onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh oregano if desired.
